rationale: Three sensors (door_back, motion_living, win_bed) dropped offline simultaneously while the base station remains online with normal uplink and other devices (including the farther front camera) stay online. The base station log shows E-610 (radio module self-test warning), which the fault-code reference and historical case H-05 identify as a sub-GHz radio module failure requiring escalation. Battery levels are normal and RSSI history was normal, ruling out weak signal or battery issues.

output.suspected_root_cause: Sub-GHz radio module failure in the base station, as indicated by E-610 and simultaneous loss of multiple sensors.

results.text: Three sensors in different rooms went offline at the same minute; base station online, RSSI history normal, E-610 in log. Restarting did not help. Escalated; radio module replaced. Escalated correctly.
Logged by the base station when its sub-GHz radio fails self-test or multiple peripherals drop simultaneously. Always escalate to FAE.
All devices offline, base station LED solid red. Router had been replaced the previous day and the Ethernet cable was in the wrong port. Resolved at frontline.

complaint: Three sensors stopped responding within seconds of each other yesterday evening. I restarted the base station, hoping it would help, but they all stayed offline. The base station is at the far end of the flat from some of them, so maybe the signal is the problem. The front camera, which is farther away, is still online though.
